findings.why_it_matters: 14.8.40.3 SUBTRACT general rule 1 (format 1): the printed subscripts 1, 2 and n on operand-1 (the first, second and n-th occurrence of operand-1) were flattened onto the baseline, so the equivalent arithmetic expression for the initial evaluation reads as references to nonexistent operands named operand-11, operand-12 and operand-1n.

14.8.40.3 SUBTRACT general rule 2 (format 2): the same flattened subscripts on operand-1 make the expression defining the GIVING result reference operand-11, operand-12 and operand-1n instead of the indexed occurrences of operand-1.
